incident_spec.summary: PostgreSQL performance degradation observed, with operations taking 4x longer than usual.
symptoms: Database backup duration increased from ~1 hour to ~4 hours.
Data synchronization between servers slowed significantly.
Queries that previously took seconds now hang for days.
High memory usage and swapping observed on one server.
incident_spec.mechanism: Potential Linux kernel settings and PostgreSQL configuration issues impacting I/O and memory management.
